name: Foreign Exchange Terms 34
definition: Information needed to process a currency exchange or conversion.

UnitCurrency.name: Unit Currency
UnitCurrency.definition: Currency in which the rate of exchange is expressed in a currency exchange. In the example 1GBP = xxxCUR, the unit currency is GBP.

QuotedCurrency.name: Quoted Currency
QuotedCurrency.definition: Currency into which the base currency is converted, in a currency exchange.

ExchangeRate.name: Exchange Rate
ExchangeRate.definition: The value of one currency expressed in relation to another currency. ExchangeRate expresses the ratio between UnitCurrency and QuotedCurrency (ExchangeRate = UnitCurrency/QuotedCurrency).

QuotationDate.name: Quotation Date
QuotationDate.definition: Date and time at which an exchange rate is quoted.

QuotingInstitution.name: Quoting Institution
QuotingInstitution.definition: Party that proposes a foreign exchange rate.
